default.notes: Short-stay eVisa via evisa.gov.ge (about USD 25 including service fee, 30 days within a 120-day window). Holders of a valid visa or residence permit from the US, UK, EU/Schengen, GCC and certain other countries can instead enter visa-free for 90 days.

groups.notes: Visa-free for a full year (365 days) under Georgia’s ordinary visa-free regime — one of the most generous allowances anywhere.
Iranian citizens travel visa-free for short stays (45 days) under the bilateral arrangement — confirm current status on geoconsul.gov.ge before travel.
Visa-free for short stays (30 days) under the visa-waiver arrangements with China in force since 28 May 2024 — confirm the exact allowance on geoconsul.gov.ge before a longer trip.
A visa from a Georgian embassy or consulate is required — this nationality is not eligible for the standard eVisa; check geoconsul.gov.ge for the application procedure.

XK.notes: Georgia does not recognise Kosovo, and Kosovo passports are generally not accepted — contact a Georgian mission about travel-document options before planning any trip.

TW.notes: Georgia does not recognise the Taiwanese passport and entry on it is generally not possible — contact a Georgian mission about travel-document options before planning any trip.
